fit.gap_handling_summary: The application presents a strong, credible stack match with unusually relevant accessibility, mobile-performance, identity-verification and A/B-testing evidence. It correctly retains WCAG 2.1 AA rather than upgrading it to 2.2 AA, limits Next.js to marketing pages, and distinguishes project leadership from the formal job title. It does not invent healthcare, GDPR or OWASP expertise, but leaves health-data learning motivation and some security fundamentals unaddressed.

issues: The Sjöbris role heading is stranded at the bottom of page 1, while all its bullets appear on page 2.
The extensive technology inventory and repeated current-role technology list dilute the focus on this particular position.
Driving licence and hobbies receive space that could be reduced in a tightly targeted technical CV.

reasons: The PDF extraction preserves sensible reading order and intact technical terms.
The central React, TypeScript, NestJS and PostgreSQL requirements are backed by dated professional experience.
Git workflows are evidenced through GitHub Actions and GitLab CI, and mentoring is expressed as a mentor role.
BankID identity verification provides relevant authentication experience without using that exact keyword.
WCAG 2.2 AA, GDPR and OWASP are not claimed; their absence should not be repaired through unsupported additions.

issues: The third paragraph repeats designer/Figma collaboration and Jest/Playwright testing in consecutive sentences.
Company tailoring is accurate but fairly shallow: it uses the healthcare mission and booking/follow-up context without engaging with the privacy-by-default principle or the WCAG 2.2 AA target.
The letter does not address learning health-data privacy requirements; it appropriately avoids claiming existing GDPR or healthcare expertise.
Much of the letter repeats CV detail rather than adding a sharper explanation of the transition from fintech onboarding to patient experience.
strengths: Names Verdane Care and the Patient Experience role correctly.
Uses directly relevant, supported conversion and mobile-performance metrics.
Connects identity verification, scanned uploads and accessibility to the target product domain without inventing health-sector experience.
Keeps project leadership, mentoring and language proficiency within the source material.
Fits on one page with a professional salutation and close.

spacing_issues: The Sjöbris Digital Agency role heading and dates are orphaned at the bottom of CV page 1; the corresponding bullets begin page 2.
CV page 1 is noticeably denser than page 2, with a long skills block and a repeated technology list.
Justified skills lines create some uneven inter-word spacing.
issues: The orphaned role heading is the main pagination defect despite the automated measurements reporting no problems.
The matching serif typography is professional and legible at 11 pt; neither document shows clipping or overlap.
The cover letter's lower-page whitespace is acceptable for a one-page letter.

fluency_and_tone_issues: “collaborate closely with designers in Figma. I work with designers in Figma” repeats the same point immediately.
“automated tests including Jest and Playwright” followed shortly by “automated unit and end-to-end tests with Jest and Playwright” is redundant and reads as insufficiently edited.

parsed.summary: This is a strong, factually faithful application with excellent React/TypeScript/NestJS/PostgreSQL alignment and well-supported accessibility, conversion and mobile-performance achievements. Important scope limits are preserved, including WCAG 2.1 AA, marketing-only Next.js work, project-level leadership and an AWS course without certification. The main weaknesses are a visibly orphaned CV role heading and an unedited repetition in the cover letter. Health-data privacy learning and broader security fundamentals remain underdeveloped, but the documents do not fabricate expertise or work-arrangement commitments.
